{"rationale":"The evidence shows carol.tan@eproc.test used the dba break-glass role far outside normal hours (02:05–02:23 UTC vs 08:00–17:00 baseline) to overwrite bank_account_snapshot on all 12,000 payment rows to a single value, delete 2,400 payment records, truncate and drop public.bids_archive, and delete 1,272 audit_log rows—direct evidence destruction. This is consistent with T1485 and financial fraud staging. The remediation locks the Teleport principal to prevent re-entry, terminates active database sessions from the suspect address, snapshots the payments table into a quarantine table for forensic review, and suspends every payment carrying the tampered bank account to block fraudulent disbursement. Recovery of the dropped bids_archive table, deleted payment rows, and deleted audit_log rows requires point-in-time backup restoration, which is out of scope for this artefact.","language":"bash","script":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# 1. Lock the Teleport principal to block re-authentication
tctl lock --user=carol.tan@eproc.test --ttl=24h \
  --message="ALRT-0016: data tampering and evidence destruction in procurement database"

# 2. Terminate suspect sessions, preserve evidence, suspend tampered payments
psql -U dba -d procurement -h localhost -p 5432 <<'EOSQL'
-- Terminate active backends originating from the suspect principal
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE usename = 'dba'
  AND client_addr = '10.20.9.5'::inet
  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();

BEGIN;

-- Forensic snapshot of the entire payments table (post-tampering, pre-suspension)
CREATE TABLE public.quarantine_alrt0016_payments AS
SELECT now() AS quarantined_at, p.*
FROM public.payments p;

-- Suspend every payment whose bank_account_snapshot was overwritten
UPDATE public.payments
SET status = 'suspended_alrt0016'
WHERE bank_account_snapshot = '99887766';

-- Append remediation record to audit_log (insert only, no mutation)
INSERT INTO public.audit_log
  (occurred_at, db_user, teleport_user, session_id, action, object_schema, object_name, statement_digest)
VALUES
  (now(), 'dba', 'remediation-engine', 'ALRT-0016', 'REMEDIATION_SUSPEND', 'public', 'payments',
   'Suspended payments with tampered bank_account_snapshot per ALRT-0016');

COMMIT;
EOSQL
